phoneConversation.speaker: GAKU
phoneConversation.text: Gaku. Don’t tell me you’ve forgotten. We go back a long way, you and me.

phoneConversation.speaker: GAKU
phoneConversation.text: You come back to work, your daughter walks free. Simple as that.

phoneConversation.speaker: GAKU
phoneConversation.text: I need my killer back, Zenji.

phoneConversation.speaker: GAKU
phoneConversation.text: Did you really think you could leave all that behind?

phoneConversation.speaker: ZENJI
phoneConversation.text: Lay a finger on her, and I’ll carve you into pieces.

phoneConversation.speaker: GAKU
phoneConversation.text: Then you’d better hurry. Keep me waiting, and you won’t see her alive again.

d.girlProtest: Let go! Get your hands off me!
d.bikerPhoneLine:
You won’t need it, sweetie.
That piece of junk led us straight to you. Getting into it was easy.

d.girlWarning: My father’s gonna kick your asses!

d.message:
Dad sends me a location and tells me to get off the bus here after school…
Why here, of all places?
And where is he?

Bro, that’s her.
Hey, kid—got a minute?

d.bikerReply: I know your dad. Come on, kid. I’ll give you a ride home.
d.girlReply: I’m not a kid. And you stink of weed.
d.bikerDemand: That’s the least of your problems, sweetheart. Get in the car.
